data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 雨后水洼的小跳跃
data.description: 雨刚停，十香穿橙色雨衣和背带长裤，轻轻迈跳过小水洼，在两只雨靴落地后开心地抬起手。她回头看水面还在扩散的涟漪，长发跟着转身扬起，像发现新游戏般高兴。
data.action: 跳过水洼稳稳落地，回头开心看着涟漪。
data.camera: full body, eye level, nearby environmental portrait
data.promptProse: Tohka lands both yellow rain boots beyond a small puddle and lifts her hands in delight at the successful little hop. Her orange rain jacket covers navy full-length dungarees. Turning back to inspect the widening ripples, she swings her long dark-purple hair with an entirely open smile. Soft light after the rain keeps her face and grounded boots readable.
